title: Engineering Tools Technical Support Analyst - Systems Enginering

cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for an Engineering Tools Technical Support Analyst to join our team. The support analyst is responsible for the day-to-day support of the Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked]. The vast majority of tools are commercial (COTS) or open source. General support activities include developing and executing installation procedures & automation, application testing, troubleshooting, responding to service desk break/fix tickets and service requests, how-to questions and documenting changes to the production environment in accordance to internal and DFARS policies and procedures.
The candidate should be customer service oriented, attentive to detail, strong leadership skills, self-motivated and work well in teams. Flexibility in approach to finding solutions, the ability to understand and act on the customer needs and priorities, and learn new technologies quickly are some of the qualities a successful candidate will have. You will also need to be willing to respond to occasional off-hours outages and take part in subsequent service restoration efforts.
Required skills include a strong knowledge and working experience of Software Engineering Tool environments. Examples include Change/Synergy, Atlassian Suite (JIRA, Bitbucket, Confluence) or Gitlab.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Design, operation and support of Systems Engineering Tools. Administration and operational support of multiple Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked]. Troubleshoot performance, availability and overall health of tool environments. Assist in planning and upgrading of applications using Windows and Linux servers and client environments. Create and maintain documentation for engineering application client and server installations and upgrades. Support users in a timely manner using ServiceNow Help Desk ticketing system. Interested candidates should have good communication and organizational skills, and a working experience administering of Systems Engineering Tool environments. Candidate should also exhibit sound judgement, initiative and self-motivation, and be able to complete tasks with minimal supervision. Attention to detail, solid communication and teamwork skills will be required to work effectively. Close collaboration with peers, Engineering and Engineering Tools personnel is essential. The ability to manage time effectively while dealing with a variety of issues in a dynamic environment will be key to the success of this individual.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proven experience with complex application installation and upgrades within Client Server architecture on the Microsoft and Redhat operating systems.
Strong understanding of security and regulatory compliance requirements.
Strong understanding of service lifecycle management.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly.
Excellent customer service skills at all levels.
Ability to work well in a team environment, in either a lead or participant role.
Must be [Location masked] Citizen.
Working experience administering server/client application environments. Examples include IBM DOORS Classic and DOORS Next Generation, MagicDraw and Teamwork Cloud.
DFARS compliance.
Detail orientated.
Ability to multi-task and reprioritize work, as required, to meet dynamic customer service environment.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of automation techniques supporting application management e.g. Installation, information extraction, or monitoring.
General understanding of Engineering disciplines and tools.
Experience supporting DevOps environments.
Scripting experience with PowerShell, SQL, Perl, Bash, Python, VBA, C or other scripting languages.
Experience working with virtualized environments such as VMware Workstation and VCenter.
Experience deployment/configuration/migration for Apache, IIS, Tomcat, ASP and ASP.net.

As part of the Engineering Tools team, you will be regularly in contact with users, peers, and Engineering personnel to support Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked]. Most tools are commercial (COTS) or open source. Day-to-day support involves developing and executing installation procedures and automation, application testing, troubleshooting, responding to service desk tickets and service requests, answering how-to questions, and documenting changes to the production environment in line with internal and DFARS policies.
The right candidate is customer service oriented, attentive to detail, and works well in teams. You should be flexible in finding solutions, able to understand and act on customer needs and priorities, and pick up new technologies quickly. You will also need to be willing to respond to occasional off-hours outages and actively take part in service restoration efforts.
Required skills include strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Software Engineering Tool environments such as Change/Synergy, Atlassian Suite (JIRA, Bitbucket, Confluence), or GitLab.
cond_0069.responsibilities:
Design, operation, and support of Systems Engineering Tools.
Administer and operationally support multiple Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked].
Troubleshoot performance, availability, and overall health of tool environments.
Assist in planning and upgrading applications using Windows and Linux servers and client environments.
Create and maintain documentation for engineering application client and server installations and upgrades.
Support users in a timely manner using ServiceNow Help Desk ticketing system, staying in regular contact to resolve issues and answer questions.
Communicate clearly and often with peers, Engineering, and Engineering Tools personnel — close collaboration across these groups is a core part of the role.
Speak up early when issues arise and initiate discussions to keep stakeholders informed and aligned.
Manage time effectively while handling a variety of issues across a busy, varied workload.
cond_0069.requirements:
Proven experience with complex application installation and upgrades within Client Server architecture on Microsoft and Redhat operating systems.
Understanding of automation techniques supporting application management, e.g. Installation, information extraction, or monitoring.
Strong understanding of security and regulatory compliance requirements.
Detail oriented.
Ability to multi-task and reprioritize work as required to meet a dynamic customer service environment.
Strong understanding of service lifecycle management.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly.
Excellent customer service skills at all levels.
Ability to work well in a team environment, in either a lead or participant role.
Good communication and organizational skills.
General understanding of Engineering disciplines and tools.
Must be [Location masked] Citizen.
Working experience administering server/client application environments. Examples include IBM DOORS Classic and DOORS Next Generation, MagicDraw, and Teamwork Cloud.
Experience supporting DevOps environments.
Scripting experience with PowerShell, SQL, Perl, Bash, Python, VBA, C, or other scripting languages.
Experience working with virtualized environments such as VMware Workstation and VCenter.
DFARS compliance.
Experience with deployment/configuration/migration for Apache, IIS, Tomcat, ASP, and ASP.net.

The support analyst works alongside the Engineering Tools team on day-to-day support of the Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked]. The vast majority of tools are commercial (COTS) or open source. General support activities include coordinating installation procedures and automation, application testing, troubleshooting, responding to service desk break/fix tickets and service requests, answering how-to questions, and documenting changes to the production environment in accordance with internal and DFARS policies and procedures.
The candidate should be customer service oriented, attentive to detail, and work well in teams. Flexibility in finding solutions, the ability to understand and act on customer needs and priorities, and a willingness to learn new technologies quickly are qualities we are looking for. You will also need to be willing to respond to occasional off-hours outages and take part in service restoration efforts alongside the team.
Relevant background includes working knowledge of Software Engineering Tool environments such as Change/Synergy, Atlassian Suite (JIRA, Bitbucket, Confluence), or GitLab.
cond_0198.responsibilities:

Create and maintain documentation for engineering application client and server installations and upgrades.
Support users in a timely manner using ServiceNow Help Desk ticketing system.
Collaborate closely with peers, Engineering, and Engineering Tools personnel to resolve issues and share knowledge.
Coordinate effectively across a variety of issues, managing time and priorities in alignment with team and customer needs.
cond_0198.requirements:
Proven experience with complex application installation and upgrades within Client Server architecture on Microsoft and Redhat operating systems.
Understanding of automation techniques supporting application management e.g. Installation, information extraction, or monitoring.
Strong understanding of security and regulatory compliance requirements.
Detail oriented.
Ability to multi-task and reprioritize work, as required, to meet dynamic customer service environment.
Strong understanding of service lifecycle management.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly.
Excellent customer service skills at all levels.
Ability to work well in a team environment, in either a lead or participant role.
General understanding of engineering disciplines and tools.
Must be [Location masked] Citizen.
Working experience administering server/client application environments. Examples include IBM DOORS Classic and DOORS Next Generation, MagicDraw and Teamwork Cloud.
Experience supporting DevOps environments.
Scripting experience with PowerShell, SQL, Perl, Bash, Python, VBA, C or other scripting languages.
Experience working with virtualized environments such as VMware Workstation and VCenter.
DFARS compliance.
Experience with deployment/configuration/migration for Apache, IIS, Tomcat, ASP and ASP.net.

cond_0261.intro:
We are looking for an Engineering Tools Technical Support Analyst to join our team at [Company name masked]. As part of the Engineering Tools team, you will work alongside colleagues to support Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked]. Most tools are commercial (COTS) or open source. Support work includes coordinating on installation procedures and automation, application testing, troubleshooting, responding to service desk tickets and service requests, answering how-to questions, and documenting changes to the production environment in line with internal and DFARS policies.
The right candidate is customer-service oriented, attentive to detail, and works well with others. We are looking for someone flexible in their approach to problem-solving, able to understand and respond to customer needs, and willing to pick up new technologies as needed. You will also need to be available for occasional off-hours outages and help with service restoration efforts.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Work with the team to design, operate, and support Systems Engineering Tools.
Share in the administration and operational support of multiple Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked].
Coordinate with peers to troubleshoot performance, availability, and overall health of tool environments.
Help plan and carry out application upgrades across Windows and Linux server and client environments.
Create and maintain documentation for engineering application client and server installations and upgrades.
Support users in a timely manner using ServiceNow Help Desk ticketing system.
Collaborate closely with peers, Engineering, and Engineering Tools personnel to resolve issues and share knowledge.
Communicate clearly and stay organized to help the team work effectively across a variety of issues.
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proven experience with complex application installation and upgrades within Client Server architecture on Microsoft and Red Hat operating systems.
Working experience administering server/client application environments (e.g., IBM DOORS Classic and DOORS Next Generation, MagicDraw and Teamwork Cloud).
Strong understanding of security and regulatory compliance requirements.
Strong understanding of service lifecycle management.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly.
Ability to multi-task and reprioritize work to meet changing customer service demands.
Excellent customer service skills at all levels.
Ability to work well in a team environment, in either a lead or participant role.
Detail oriented.
Must be [Location masked] Citizen.
DFARS compliance.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of automation techniques supporting application management (e.g., installation, information extraction, or monitoring).
Experience supporting DevOps environments.
Scripting experience with PowerShell, SQL, Perl, Bash, Python, VBA, C, or other scripting languages.
Experience working with virtualized environments such as VMware Workstation and VCenter.
Experience with deployment, configuration, and migration for Apache, IIS, Tomcat, ASP, and ASP.net.
General understanding of engineering disciplines and tools.
Strong knowledge and working experience of Software Engineering Tool environments such as Change/Synergy, Atlassian Suite (JIRA, Bitbucket, Confluence), or GitLab.

cond_0397.intro:
We are looking for an Engineering Tools Technical Support Analyst to join our team. The support analyst is responsible for the day-to-day support of the Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked]. The vast majority of tools are commercial (COTS) or open source. General support activities include developing and executing installation procedures & automation, application testing, troubleshooting, responding to service desk break/fix tickets and service requests, how-to questions and documenting changes to the production environment in accordance to internal and DFARS policies and procedures.
The candidate should be customer service oriented, attentive to detail, strong leadership skills, self-motivated and work well in teams. Flexibility in approach to finding solutions, the ability to understand and act on the customer needs and priorities, and learn new technologies quickly are some of the qualities a successful candidate will have. You will also need to be willing to respond to occasional off-hours outages and take part in subsequent service restoration efforts.
Required skills include a strong knowledge and working experience of Software Engineering Tool environments. Examples include Change/Synergy, Atlassian Suite (JIRA, Bitbucket, Confluence) or Gitlab.
cond_0397.responsibilities: Design, operation and support of Systems Engineering Tools. Administration and operational support of multiple Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked]. Troubleshoot performance, availability and overall health of tool environments. Assist in planning and upgrading of applications using Windows and Linux servers and client environments. Create and maintain documentation for engineering application client and server installations and upgrades. Support users in a timely manner using ServiceNow Help Desk ticketing system. Interested candidates should have good communication and organizational skills, and a working experience administering of Systems Engineering Tool environments. Candidate should also exhibit sound judgement, initiative and self-motivation, and be able to complete tasks with minimal supervision. Attention to detail, solid communication and teamwork skills will be required to work effectively. Close collaboration with peers, Engineering and Engineering Tools personnel is essential. The ability to manage time effectively while dealing with a variety of issues in a dynamic environment will be key to the success of this individual.
cond_0397.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proven experience with complex application installation and upgrades within Client Server architecture on the Microsoft and Redhat operating systems.
Strong understanding of security and regulatory compliance requirements.
Strong understanding of service lifecycle management.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly.
Excellent customer service skills at all levels.
Ability to work well in a team environment, in either a lead or participant role.
Must be [Location masked] Citizen.
Working experience administering server/client application environments. Examples include IBM DOORS Classic and DOORS Next Generation, MagicDraw and Teamwork Cloud.
DFARS compliance.
Detail orientated.
Ability to multi-task and reprioritize work, as required, to meet dynamic customer service environment.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of automation techniques supporting application management e.g. Installation, information extraction, or monitoring.
General understanding of Engineering disciplines and tools.
Experience supporting DevOps environments.
Scripting experience with PowerShell, SQL, Perl, Bash, Python, VBA, C or other scripting languages.
Experience working with virtualized environments such as VMware Workstation and VCenter.
Experience deployment/configuration/migration for Apache, IIS, Tomcat, ASP and ASP.net.

As part of the Engineering Tools team, you will work alongside colleagues to support Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked]. Most tools are commercial (COTS) or open source. Support work includes coordinating on installation procedures and automation, application testing, troubleshooting, responding to service desk tickets and service requests, answering how-to questions, and documenting changes to the production environment in line with internal and DFARS policies.
The right candidate is customer-service oriented, attentive to detail, and works well with others. We are looking for someone flexible in their approach to problem-solving, able to understand and respond to customer needs, and willing to pick up new technologies as needed. You will also need to be available for occasional off-hours outages and help with service restoration efforts.
cond_0567.responsibilities:
Work with the team to design, operate, and support Systems Engineering Tools.
Share in the administration and operational support of multiple Systems Engineering application environments across [Company name masked].
Coordinate with peers to troubleshoot performance, availability, and overall health of tool environments.
Help plan and carry out application upgrades across Windows and Linux server and client environments.
Create and maintain documentation for engineering application client and server installations and upgrades.
Support users in a timely manner using ServiceNow Help Desk ticketing system.
Collaborate closely with peers, Engineering, and Engineering Tools personnel to resolve issues and share knowledge.
Communicate clearly and stay organized to help the team work effectively across a variety of issues.
cond_0567.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Proven experience with complex application installation and upgrades within Client Server architecture on Microsoft and Red Hat operating systems.
Working experience administering server/client application environments (e.g., IBM DOORS Classic and DOORS Next Generation, MagicDraw and Teamwork Cloud).
Strong understanding of security and regulatory compliance requirements.
Strong understanding of service lifecycle management.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to identify and resolve issues quickly.
Ability to multi-task and reprioritize work to meet changing customer service demands.
Excellent customer service skills at all levels.
Ability to work well in a team environment, in either a lead or participant role.
Detail oriented.
Must be [Location masked] Citizen.
DFARS compliance.
Preferred Requirements
Understanding of automation techniques supporting application management (e.g., installation, information extraction, or monitoring).
Experience supporting DevOps environments.
Scripting experience with PowerShell, SQL, Perl, Bash, Python, VBA, C, or other scripting languages.
Experience working with virtualized environments such as VMware Workstation and VCenter.
Experience with deployment, configuration, and migration for Apache, IIS, Tomcat, ASP, and ASP.net.
General understanding of engineering disciplines and tools.
Strong knowledge and working experience of Software Engineering Tool environments such as Change/Synergy, Atlassian Suite (JIRA, Bitbucket, Confluence), or GitLab.
